incremental.bootstrap_policy: Requires explicit bounded --from without same-target verified checkpoint, and rejects a nonempty isolated target without receipt-backed coverage.
incremental.revision_overlap: Re-fetch up to 30 calendar days before checkpoint through, clamped to frozen bootstrap anchor.
incremental.checkpoint_policy: Only contiguous same-target, same-definition VERIFIED/VERIFIED_EMPTY INCREMENTAL runs with exact frozen calendar-day receipts advance; BACKFILL does not advance.
incremental.target_range_policy: Compare target announcement-date inventory and every key/value against the complete receipt chain. Any unexplained date, key, or value fails closed.

mapping_drift.calendar_dates: ann_date and end_date are LocalDate values persisted as UTC-midnight TIMESTAMP carriers; they are not instants.
mapping_drift.numeric_fields: mkv, amount, stk_mkv_ratio, stk_float_ratio remain nullable finite provider DOUBLE values without scaling.
mapping_drift.update_time: Derived frozen UTC observation Instant at microsecond precision; excluded from the provider source field list but included in physical row verification.
mapping_drift.source_revocations: RECONCILE is not exposed because this upsert writer cannot remove keys safely. After-write complete date comparison rejects extra stale physical keys rather than accepting an incomplete match.
mapping_drift.missing_ann_date: Java rejects missing/blank ann_date instead of using the Python compatibility fallback to end_date; request-scope membership must be proven.
